decisions.rule: Classify SMBC's 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing as confirmed by SBI's primary October 30 release; distinguish agreement from completed closing.
Represent JPYSC/OUSD interoperability as an exploratory proof-of-concept, not a live bridge or settlement route.
Coinbase's Open Standard membership is a consortium-level overlap; do not infer a direct Coinbase-JPYSC commercial agreement.
Keep issuer-confirmed September 7 JPY20.1B and secondary-reported October 30 JPY20.8B as separate timestamped observations until issuer confirmation.
